notes: Development-only unknown-group complementary-sharing experiment. Initial blocks are balanced independently within physical families, but family labels are used only for oracle comparison and retrospective ARI. LearnedCluster fits a mixture of L=7 LPV regressions directly to each client's observed speed--matrix pairs; it never requires a locally identified L=7 model. K in 1..5 is selected by BIC over standardized observation residuals, with at least five clients per cluster and multiple deterministic restarts. Evaluation compares Local, Global, LearnedCluster, OracleFamily, equal-budget LocalFull, and ExactLPV on full-envelope matrix error and guarded nonlinear recovery.
